I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm or contradict the 8 April renewal date.

I only checked what Pree can see. There are no Brackenwater Freight Co. files (contract, CRM notes or profile) in the share. Brackenwater also isn't mentioned in #central-team or in any of the Central digests and notes.

I haven't recorded the date anywhere as a fact. In the reply I suggested getting it confirmed in writing by the Brackenwater contact, or checked against the contract by the account owner, before anyone plans around it. I offered to help draft that request if Pree tells me who owns the account.
